search.snippet: July 29, 2026 - A mind tiara is a head slot item used in Runecrafting. It can be created at the Mind altar by using a blank tiara on the altar while also having a Mind talisman in your inventory. Doing this combines the two and grants 27 Runecrafting experience. While the mind tiara is equipped, the mysterious ruins to the mind altar gain a left click "enter" option.
